policy.input: G call-01 original generation.images[0], full actual input, no VLM points/ROI
policy.cross_class_policy: retain all; IoU>=0.5 pairs reported only, no suppression
policy.count_rule: score >= validation-selected shared threshold; predicted candidates, not truth lower bounds
policy.fusion: any known G nut/washer count exceeded => both unknown; no count repairs

protocol.augmentation: independent horizontal/vertical flip p=0.5; train only
protocol.screws_washer_policy: No washer-positive annotations; zero means no projected author washer target, not field absence
protocol.postprocessing_boundary: All returned boxes retained after frozen detector score floor 0.05/NMS0.5/max100
protocol.balance: 0.5*Screws image mean + 0.5*FOD validation source-group macro mean
protocol.held_back_policy: no held_back manifest/image reads; no held-back evaluation command
protocol.initialization: original COCO state; replace 91-class head with four outputs
protocol.claim_limit: Source groups are not certified physical objects. FOD count truth is author targets only.
protocol.mps_determinism: Seeds fixed; bitwise MPS reproducibility not guaranteed
